answers.core:
I believe it's important to recognize when arbitrary design choices are made (like favoring top-to-bottom, or in the case of other controls the top-left anchor) and reconcile them with other equal possibilities. 

Top-to-bottom listing in VBoxContainers may be seen as generally acceptable in Godot, but it's a design limitation that dictates the UI of every Godot game. It's important to imagine other possibilities.
answers.workaround: There is no simple workaround, unless you mess with Z-Indexing.
